description: Kill an `fsk_` project API key. Anything using it — a script, a CI job, another agent — stops immediately and it cannot be restored; mint a new key and update the consumer. `confirm` must be the key id exactly, from fillo_list_api_keys. Use the user's explicit authorization for this action and target. Ask if it is missing. Needs a LOGIN TOKEN, so a leaked key can never revoke the workspace's other keys.

confirm.description: The exact API key id for this irreversible action. Supply it only when the user explicitly authorized this action on this target. Otherwise ask for their decision.

name: fillo_revoke_api_key
title: Revoke a project API key
